lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into at least five distinct longitudinal rows with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a series of high-luminance nodal points across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from high-intensity pixels on the superior edge to lower-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.
